name: SlideShare

sources.title: SlideShare sign-in/sign-up — Continue with Scribd, LinkedIn, or Email
SlideShare upload page — supported file types and uploader agreement

requirements: Account required: sign up with Scribd, LinkedIn, or Email
Supported upload formats: PowerPoint (PPT, PPTX, PPSX, POTX), PDF, Word (DOC, DOCX)
Uploader must agree to the Slideshare Uploader Agreement; only upload work you created — DMCA-compliant 'three-strikes' infringement policy terminates repeat infringers
SlideShare is operated by Scribd (copyright © 2026 'Slideshare from Scribd')
preparation: A presentation/deck about the product (e.g. pitch deck, feature overview) as PPTX or PDF
Title, description, and category for the upload
Landing URL to embed inside the deck — the deck itself is the distribution asset
workflow: Create an account at slideshare.net/signup (Scribd, LinkedIn, or Email)
Go to slideshare.net/upload and drag-and-drop or select the deck (cloud import from Google Drive, Box, OneDrive available)
Share/embed the public Slideshare page — uploads are indexed by Google per the upload page
watchFor: This is document sharing, not a product directory — value is an indexable hosted deck, not a profile listing
Strict IP enforcement ('three-strikes'); only upload original material
Signup page renders a sign-in form first — the /signup link is the registration entry
Link attribute (dofollow/nofollow) of URLs inside decks is unverified
countsAsLive: A public slideshare.net/<user>/<deck> URL serving the uploaded presentation
unknowns: Whether links inside decks/profile are followed
